execution: Open three separate fresh regular ChatGPT chats outside the Ensemble project, one per primary packet.
For each chat, paste only the complete text contents of that packet as the first and only generation request; do not upload the packet file if doing so exposes repository path or project metadata.
Generate exactly one image in each chat. Do not request revision, alternative, reroll, or explanation.
Do not show any generated primary image to either of the other primary renderer chats.
Return the three untouched images together to Design Sol in R1, R2, R3 order. Preserve platform-returned bytes if available.
Do not execute any TRANSFER packet until all three primary images are frozen and evaluated.
stop_conditions: If a chat returns a judgeable image, that primary slot is consumed regardless of pass/fail.
A genuine no-image technical failure may retry only with byte-identical packet text.
Any accidental exposure to project history, another CTF/VFD image, or extra prompt text invalidates that renderer context before generation; start a fresh context with exact packet text.
